pairing_decision_v2.decided_by: 🕯 (Discord msg 1572252647791005697), relayed by the v2 workorder addendum 2026-11-17 14:12Z
pairing_decision_v2.decision_verbatim: I choose pairing for the proof client only. Keep Emeric on `auth.mode=none`; do not switch it to token mode. Verify and approve the k6 proof-client identity in the gateway pairing flow, then revoke it after the receipt.
pairing_decision_v2.outcome: not executable with the docs harness at 9ba5518b against product ab5a30ea; no device was approved, no config key was read beyond booleans/mode strings, nothing on emeric was changed
why: The readiness client sends no device identity. Its connect params are client {id:'cli', mode:'cli'}, role operator, scopes [operator.read] and auth.token, with no `device` field (tools/k6-proofs/scripts/target-readiness.mjs:191-212 at 9ba5518b). Nothing under tools/k6-proofs outside tests signs a device identity.

At ab5a30ea a device-less connect is decided in handleMissingDeviceIdentity (src/gateway/server/ws-connection/connect-auth.ts:272-335): evaluateMissingDeviceIdentity returns reject-device-required (connect-policy.ts:69-98), which sends NOT_PAIRED 'device identity required' and closes 1008. That happens before the pairing branch.

requestDevicePairing, the only creator of a pending request, runs only inside `if (device && devicePublicKey)` (connect-device-pairing.ts:146, call at :242). A device-less client can never produce a pending request.

Even a device-bearing readiness client would not produce one on emeric. gateway.nodes.pairing.autoApproveLocal is unset (default on), a loopback client resolves to locality direct_local (handshake-auth-helpers.ts:133), and shouldAllowSilentLocalPairing returns true for a not-paired local operator (handshake-auth-helpers.ts:63-110; connect-pairing-approval-plan.ts:139). The request would be created silent and self-approved on first connect, leaving nothing pending to verify or approve.
At ab5a30ea `openclaw devices revoke` requires --device and --role and revokes one role token (src/cli/devices-cli.ts). Removing the paired-device entry is `openclaw devices remove <deviceId>`.

C. Token mode on emeric (ruled out by 🕯).
D. An isolated token-auth proof gateway on emeric (contradicts the live-gateway spec; needs a stage-only deploy).
